Priority Question Answer:
The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.

Thematic Segments of Provided Content:

1. Definition and Scope of Nutrition Science
Nutrition science examines how organisms use food to function, grow, and maintain health. It studies nutrients, dietary habits, and food systems to understand their impact on well-being.

2. Negative Health Impacts of Poor Nutrition
Poor nutrition can result in a range of health issues, such as obesity, diabetes, and heart disease.

3. Positive Health Impacts of Good Nutrition
Conversely, good dietary practices can promote longevity and reduce the risk of chronic ailments.
